snippet.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – Mr. Aonuma Gameplay Demonstration
snippet.description:
Watch as series producer, Eiji Aonuma, gives a gameplay demonstration of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1036-01&utm_id=S1036-01
